title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - HealthActor
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/HealthActor. The eHealth actors like e.g. caregivers, patients, users, helpers... (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf foaf:Agent. Superclass of Caregiver, Helper, ResponsibleParty and User (and transitively Patient), which inherit every property declared here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'HealthActor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

firstName.description: Property. The first name of a health actor. ttl-confirmed, domain HealthActor (s4ehaw:firstName).

lastName.description: Property. The family name of a health actor. ttl-confirmed, domain HealthActor (s4ehaw:lastName).

dob.description: Property. The date of birth of a health actor. ttl-confirmed, domain HealthActor, range xsd:dateTime (s4ehaw:dob).

phone.description: Property. The phone number of a health actor, in international format. ttl-confirmed, domain HealthActor (s4ehaw:phone).

hasMbox.description: Property. An email address (or mail box) of a health actor: a URI with the 'mailto' scheme as defined by RFC 6068. ttl-confirmed, domain HealthActor, range xsd:anyURI (s4ehaw:hasMbox).

gender.description: Property. The gender of a health actor. ttl-confirmed State class (s4ehaw:Gender) and its 4 StateValue individuals; HealthActor carries an explicit OWL restriction rdfs:subClassOf [owl:onProperty saref:hasState; owl:hasValue s4ehaw:Gender], so this State is genuinely anchored to HealthActor by the ontology itself, via the generic reused saref:hasState mechanism (not a SAREF4EHAW-specific named object property).

ageCategory.description: Property. The age group of a health actor, e.g. old or young. ttl-confirmed State class (s4ehaw:AgeCategory) and its 2 StateValue individuals; undomained by any explicit OWL restriction, attached here to HealthActor because its own rdfs:comment reads 'of a health actor'.

hasPhysicalLocation.description: GeoProperty. geo:json. The physical location (geolocation) of this health actor. Property name attested verbatim in ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.3.1's worked Covid-19 proximity-detection example ('the geolocation property (s4ehaw:hasPhysicalLocation property) of patients... computed using the latitude and longitude... with the Haversine formula'); NOT found as a declared triple in the published saref4ehaw.ttl. Mapped here to the ttl's confirmed generic Location State class (s4ehaw:Location), whose own definition explicitly covers 'a physical location (a postal address, a geolocation)', as distinct from its LocationRelativeToBody branch used on HealthDevice for on-body/implant placement. HealthActor also carries the matching explicit OWL restriction hasState hasValue Location in the ttl.

usesBan.description: Relationship. A health actor (e.g. a caregiver, a patient or a helper) uses a BAN for collecting, aggregating and relaying vital parameters. ttl-confirmed, domain HealthActor, range Ban (s4ehaw:usesBan). Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Ban'. May also be an array of URIs when a health actor uses more than one BAN.

hasActivity.description: Relationship. A health actor may have one or multiple activities. ttl-confirmed, domain HealthActor, range Activity (s4ehaw:hasActivity). Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Activity'. May also be an array of URIs when a health actor has more than one activity.
